title: A Neural Probabilistic Language Model
summary: Yoshua Bengio, Réjean Ducharme, Pascal Vincent, and Christian Jauvin published A Neural Probabilistic Language Model in the Journal of Machine Learning Research in February 2003. The paper proposed learning distributed word representations jointly with a neural probability function for word sequences to address generalization limits associated with the curse of dimensionality.
significance: A documented neural language-modeling research milestone combining learned distributed word representations with a neural network probability model for word sequences.
